svg.title: Cursor Entry Motion Path
svg.desc: A continuous cursor-entry trajectory reconstructed from the supplied sketch. The cursor begins at the marked start point, loops through the lower-left portion, crosses the center, loops through the upper-right portion, and finishes at the right-side click-logo endpoint.
